DINERBOT T8

Optimized capabilities in a compact design

key feature

<

>

Smart Self-Pickup Guidance

Made possible by tray sensors, a 300° open tray, and voice and visual guidance on the 10.1" touch screen.

Compact, for Enhanced Agility

Our compact robot navigates spaces as narrow as 55 cm, ensuring maneuverability in cozy environments.

Safety, Elevated

DINERBOT T8 uses 3 stereo vision sensors, detecting common high obstacles and those under 5cm, for precise, safe service in any environment.

Precise navigation and positioning

Craft precise positioning maps with seamless spatial data collection for trustworthy reliability.

Synergizing 3D perception with instant response

Precise environmental perception for swift avoidance.

Patented algorithms and multi-robot dispatching

Patented AI algorithms empower robots to optimize route planning for efficient task execution.

Safety, Elevated

DINERBOT T8 uses 3 stereo vision sensors, detecting common high obstacles and those under 5cm, for precise, safe service in any environment.

Stability, Engineered

DINERBOT T8 integrates a self-developed 4.0 shock-absorbing chassis, featuring rigid stabilizer construction and premium-grade materials—ensuring unwavering stability with every step.
